title: BluCooldown
description: Minecraft Paper/Folia plugin for adding fully configurable cooldowns to items
body:
# BluCooldown

BluCooldown is a lightweight and high-performance Minecraft Paper/Folia plugin for adding fully configurable cooldowns to items , Supports Minecraft 1.21+ and Java 21.

## Features

- Fully configurable
- Async-safe
- Folia support
- Lightweight
- Java 21
- High performance

## Author

Macronis
